title: Not Your White Woman's Feminism
author: Sibyl
description: Each episode deconstructs patriarchal ideologies and "Father God" archetypes, exploring spirituality, culture, and social conditioning through the lens of Black womanhood. We challenge colorism as a global extension of racism and patriarchy, and critique white-centric feminism for excluding Black women and ignoring intersections of race, class, and systemic oppression. While centering Black women and femmes, NYWWF welcomes all committed to unlearning, decolonizing, and embracing divine feminine energy.
